cards.card_text: Joseph tells the cupbearer he did something to deserve being put in this dungeon.
cards.verse_text: For I was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.”
cards.snippet: …have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.”

cards.card_text: Joseph is quickly brought out of the dungeon, shaves, changes his clothes and goes in before Pharaoh.
cards.verse_text: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, who was quickly brought out of the dungeon.
cards.snippet: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, who was quickly brought out of the dungeon.

cards.card_text: It reaches from the firstborn of Pharaoh on his throne to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, and all the firstborn among the livestock.
cards.verse_text: Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on his throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, as well as all the firstborn among the livestock.
cards.snippet: …sat on his throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, as well as all the firstborn among the livestock.

cards.card_text: They'll be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.
cards.verse_text: They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.
cards.snippet: They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.

cards.card_text: And to bring prisoners out of the dungeon, and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house.
cards.verse_text: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring prisoners out of the dungeon and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house.
cards.snippet: …open the eyes of the blind, to bring prisoners out of the dungeon and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house.

cards.card_text: But look at the people: plundered and looted, all trapped in caves or imprisoned in dungeons.
cards.verse_text: But this is a people plundered and looted, all trapped in caves or imprisoned in dungeons.
cards.snippet: …a people plundered and looted, all trapped in caves or imprisoned in dungeons.

cards.card_text: The LORD says the captive will soon be ___ and will not die in the dungeon.
cards.verse_text: The captive will soon be freed; he will not die in the dungeon, and his bread will not be lacking.
cards.snippet: The captive will soon be freed; he will not die in the dungeon, and his bread will not be lacking.

cards.card_text: So Jeremiah goes into a cell in the dungeon, and he stays there a long time.
cards.verse_text: So Jeremiah went into a cell in the dungeon and remained there a long time.
cards.snippet: So Jeremiah went into a cell in the dungeon and remained there a long time.
